references.title: DWDS: meist
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Superlativ, Grundformen viel, sehr

references.title: en.wiktionary: meist
references.supports: Adverb; from OHG meist, inherited; no German surface split

notes.rationale: deren Beantwortung er meist nicht abwartete, mostly. An ADV takes no Source (ADR 0050), so DWDS's Grundform line names none. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root meist alone.
